sop_modules.name: Mobilization, Access & Administrative Gates
sop_modules.description: Crew mobilization, equipment staging, access setup, warranty void acknowledgment, and LRV verification. Administrative gates must clear before any production work.

tasks.name: Crew Mobilization & Equipment Staging
tasks.description: Mobilize crew, transport materials and equipment to site. Stage primer, finish paint, spray equipment, and protection materials at work area. Verify material against spec — confirm 100% acrylic latex binder, confirm adhesion primer is STIX class.

quality_notes.all: All materials on-site and verified against scope. Equipment in working order. Binder type confirmed on PDS.

tasks.name: Warranty Void Acknowledgment Gate
tasks.description: Obtain written client acknowledgment that painting vinyl siding voids the manufacturer finish warranty. Document manufacturer name and existing warranty status. Contractor provides workmanship warranty in lieu of manufacturer coverage. HARD STOP — do not proceed without signed acknowledgment.

quality_notes.all: Signed warranty void acknowledgment on file before any work begins. No exceptions.

tasks.name: LRV Verification Gate
tasks.description: Verify selected color LRV against vinyl-safe thresholds. LRV 55+ = standard product path. LRV 35-55 = IR-reflective products ONLY. LRV <35 = HARD STOP — reject color, do not proceed. Check product PDS for IR-reflective claim if LRV 35-55.

quality_notes.all: LRV confirmed. Product PDS verified for IR-reflective claim if LRV 35-55. Document LRV and product approval.

tasks.name: Scaffold / Lift Setup
tasks.description: Erect scaffold, position aerial lift, or stage extension ladders per access plan. OSHA-compliant setup with fall protection.

quality_notes.all: Level, plumb, tied off. Fall protection in place. Base plates on firm footing.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Mobilize → Warranty gate → LRV verify → Scaffold/lift setup. Administrative gates MUST clear before any production work.

sop_modules.name: Exterior Protection Setup
sop_modules.description: Deploy landscape, hardscape, window/door masking, trim masking, fixture covers, and HVAC protection. Spray method requires full masking of windows, doors, and trim. No RRP containment needed (vinyl is never lead-painted).

tasks.name: Landscape Protection
tasks.description: Deploy plastic sheeting and drop cloths over landscape beds, shrubs, and plantings adjacent to working elevations. Protects from pressure wash runoff, primer drips, and spray overspray.

quality_notes.all: Secure tarps at grade. Extend 3 ft minimum from foundation. Full coverage for spray method — extend to 10 ft for overspray zone.

tasks.name: Hardscape Protection
tasks.description: Deploy drop cloths on walkways, patios, and driveways adjacent to working elevations.

quality_notes.all: Tape plastic to foundation at grade line. Extend to drip/overspray zone.

tasks.name: Window Masking (Spray)
tasks.description: Mask all windows on working elevations with masking paper/film and tape. Required for spray application method to prevent overspray on glass and frames.

quality_notes.all: Full glass and frame coverage. Tape sealed at edges — no overspray paths. Paper/film extends past frame to siding overlap.

tasks.name: Door Masking (Spray)
tasks.description: Mask all exterior doors on working elevations with plastic sheeting and tape. Required for spray application.

quality_notes.all: Full door coverage including hardware. Maintain access for occupants where possible.

tasks.name: Trim Masking at Siding-to-Trim Transition
tasks.description: Tape and mask corner trim, window casing, and door casing where trim is a different color from siding. Prevents siding paint on trim surfaces during spray.

quality_notes.all: Tape line clean and straight. Paper extends 3-6 inches from edge. No exposed trim surface in spray zone.

tasks.name: Light Fixture Masking
tasks.description: Bag and tape exterior light fixtures on working elevations.

quality_notes.all: Complete coverage. Secure tape to prevent seepage during wash and spray.

tasks.name: HVAC Unit Cover
tasks.description: Cover HVAC condenser units adjacent to working elevations with plastic sheeting.

quality_notes.all: Full cover during active work. Remove promptly after — do not leave covered overnight in warm weather.

tasks.name: Utility Panel Masking
tasks.description: Mask electrical panels, gas meters, and utility boxes on working elevations.

quality_notes.all: Complete coverage. Do not obstruct access to emergency shutoffs.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Landscape → Hardscape → Window mask (spray) → Door mask (spray) → Trim mask (spray) → Light fixtures → HVAC → Utility panels. Protection BEFORE any wash or coating work.

sop_modules.name: Pressure Wash with Alkaline Cleaner
sop_modules.description: Mandatory pressure wash to remove dirt, mildew, and chalk residue from vinyl surface. First production step. Must dry 24-48 hours before priming.

tasks.name: Mix Alkaline Cleaning Solution
tasks.description: Mix TSP or dedicated vinyl siding cleaner concentrate with water per manufacturer directions. Load into pressure washer downstream injector or pump sprayer for pre-treatment.

quality_notes.all: Mix ratio per manufacturer. Solution ready before starting wash.

tasks.name: Pressure Wash Vinyl Siding
tasks.description: Pressure wash all siding surfaces using downward spray pattern. 500-1000 PSI — do NOT exceed 1500 PSI (forces water behind panels at lap joints). Remove dirt, mildew, chalk residue, and surface contamination. Work top-down, one elevation at a time.

block_when.note: High wind disperses wash water and cleaner onto adjacent properties

quality_notes.QT2: 500-800 PSI. Remove visible dirt and mildew. Allow 24 hr dry minimum.
quality_notes.QT3: 800-1000 PSI with TSP solution. Thorough chalk removal. Hand-rub test after drying to verify. Allow 24-48 hr dry.

tasks.name: Post-Wash Chalk Residue Test
tasks.description: After siding has dried, perform hand-rub test on representative areas to verify chalk removal. Rub white cloth firmly across surface — residue transfer indicates incomplete cleaning. Re-wash areas that fail.

quality_notes.QT3: Test 3+ areas per elevation. Document results. Re-wash if chalk transfer detected.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Mix cleaner → Pressure wash (top-down, elevation by elevation) → Dry 24-48 hr → Chalk residue test (QT3). Do NOT proceed to prep or prime until surface is completely dry.

sop_modules.name: Surface Preparation — Scuff & Spot Repair
sop_modules.description: Light scuff sand or liquid sander for adhesion tooth on smooth vinyl PVC surface. Minimal prep compared to wood siding — no scraping, no feather-sanding, no wood fiber treatment. Spot caulk at QT3.

tasks.name: Scuff Sand Vinyl Surface
tasks.description: Light scuff with synthetic pads (180-320 grit equivalent) to create micro-abrasion adhesion tooth on smooth vinyl PVC. Alternative: liquid sander (Krud Kutter). Focus on areas where UV chalking was heaviest.

quality_notes.QT2: Scuff high-gloss areas and visible chalk zones. Spot treatment.
quality_notes.QT3: Full-surface scuff on all elevations. Uniform matte appearance after scuffing.

tasks.name: Post-Scuff Dust Cleanup
tasks.description: Remove all scuffing dust and residue from siding surfaces before priming. Compressed air or tack wipe.

quality_notes.all: No visible dust or residue. Surface ready for adhesion primer.

tasks.name: Caulk Assessment at Siding-to-Trim Joints
tasks.description: Inspect existing caulk at siding-to-trim joints, J-channels, and penetrations. Mark failed or missing caulk for replacement. QT3 only.

quality_notes.QT3: Inspect all siding-to-trim joints. Mark failed caulk with tape flag. Document scope.

tasks.name: Spot Caulk Replacement
tasks.description: Remove failed caulk and apply new siliconized acrylic paintable caulk at siding-to-trim joints. QT3 only. Allow cure per manufacturer spec before top-coating.

quality_notes.QT3: Clean joint, apply consistent bead, tool smooth. No voids. Allow cure time.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Scuff sand → Dust cleanup → Caulk assess (QT3) → Caulk apply (QT3). Caulk must cure before primer coat.

sop_modules.name: Adhesion Primer Application
sop_modules.description: STIX-class adhesion primer spray application. Single coat, full coverage — always required for vinyl PVC. No spot prime option. Solvent-attack chemical bond to PVC surface.

tasks.name: Adhesion Primer — Spray Application
tasks.description: Spray-apply STIX-class adhesion primer to all vinyl siding surfaces. Full coverage, single coat. Even mil build — do NOT double-coat (excessive film build reduces coating flexibility). No backbrushing required — vinyl is non-porous.

quality_notes.all: Full coverage. Even mil build. No runs, sags, or holidays. Allow full cure per TDS before topcoat.

tasks.name: Adhesion Primer — Brush/Roll Application
tasks.description: Brush and roll adhesion primer when spray is not feasible (high wind, neighbor proximity). Roller for open field, brush at edges and J-channels. Full coverage single coat.

quality_notes.all: Full coverage. Even application. Maintain wet edge. No holidays.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Adhesion primer is ALWAYS required — no skip option. Method determined by application_method dimension. Allow cure per TDS before finish coat.

sop_modules.name: Finish Coat 1
sop_modules.description: First finish coat application. 100% acrylic latex exterior. Spray is primary method. For QT2 this is the only finish coat. For QT3 this is the first of two coats.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 1 — Spray Application
tasks.description: Spray-apply first finish coat of 100% acrylic exterior latex. Even coverage, consistent mil build. No backbrushing — vinyl is non-porous PVC.
tasks.material_system_note: SYS_EXT_VNRP_FINISH_STANDARD or SYS_EXT_VNRP_FINISH_IR_REFLECTIVE — determined by lrv_class at runtime

quality_notes.QT2: Even coverage. No drips or holidays. Single pass sufficient.
quality_notes.QT3: Uniform mil build. No visible spray pattern at 6 ft. Consistent appearance across all elevations.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 1 — Brush/Roll Application
tasks.description: Brush and roll first finish coat when spray is not feasible. Roller for open field, brush at edges and transitions.
tasks.material_system_note: SYS_EXT_VNRP_FINISH_STANDARD or SYS_EXT_VNRP_FINISH_IR_REFLECTIVE — determined by lrv_class at runtime

quality_notes.QT3: Even coverage. No brush marks in roller field. Maintain wet edge.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: First finish coat after adhesion primer has cured. Method determined by application_method. QT2 = final coat. QT3 proceeds to coat 2.

sop_modules.name: Finish Coat 2
sop_modules.description: Second (final) finish coat. QT3 only — QT2 uses single finish coat. No interstage sanding between coats (vinyl surface does not require intercoat abrasion).

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Spray Application
tasks.description: Second and final finish coat by spray. Critical for full hide, proper DFT, and maximum durability. Allow recoat time per TDS between coats.
tasks.material_system_note: SYS_EXT_VNRP_FINISH_STANDARD or SYS_EXT_VNRP_FINISH_IR_REFLECTIVE — determined by lrv_class at runtime

quality_notes.QT3: Uniform mil build. Consistent appearance across all elevations. No visible spray pattern at 6 ft.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Brush/Roll Application
tasks.description: Second and final finish coat by brush and roller.
tasks.material_system_note: SYS_EXT_VNRP_FINISH_STANDARD or SYS_EXT_VNRP_FINISH_IR_REFLECTIVE — determined by lrv_class at runtime

quality_notes.QT3: Even coverage. No brush marks in roller field. Maintain wet edge to natural break points.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Second and final finish coat. QT3 only. Allow recoat time per TDS. QT2 stops after coat 1.

sop_modules.name: Brush Detail — J-Channels & Transitions
sop_modules.description: Brush detail at J-channels, under-sill channels, corner transitions, and trim cut-in. QT3 only — this is the primary labor differentiator between tiers.

tasks.name: Brush Detail — J-Channels & Under-Sill
tasks.description: Brush-apply finish coat into J-channels, under-sill channels, and starter strip recesses. Spray may not fully penetrate these recessed areas — brush ensures full coating coverage in channels.

quality_notes.QT3: Full coverage in all channel recesses. No bare PVC visible in channels. Clean transitions at channel-to-field junction.

tasks.name: Brush Cut-In at Trim Transitions
tasks.description: Brush cut-in where siding meets corner trim, window casing, door casing, and soffit junction. Clean color line at siding-to-trim boundary.

quality_notes.QT3: Sharp color line at trim boundary. No bleed onto trim surface. Consistent line at 6 ft viewing.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Detail work after final spray coat has set (tack-free). J-channels first, then trim cut-in.

sop_modules.name: Cleanup & Demobilization
sop_modules.description: Remove all protection materials, clean spray equipment, scaffold teardown, site restoration. No RRP cleanup required (vinyl is never lead-painted).

tasks.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection
tasks.description: Walk all elevations and inspect completed siding finish for defects, holidays, coverage, and appearance.

quality_notes.QT2: Ground-level walkthrough at 10 ft viewing distance.
quality_notes.QT3: Ground-level walkthrough at 6 ft viewing distance. Binoculars for upper elevations.

tasks.name: Final Touch-Up
tasks.description: Brush touch-up of defects found during final walkthrough inspection.

quality_notes.QT2: Fix obvious defects at ground-level viewing distance.
quality_notes.QT3: Fix all noted defects. Blend seamlessly at 6 ft.

tasks.name: Remove All Protection Materials
tasks.description: Remove all masking tape, masking paper/film, drop cloths, plastic sheeting, landscape tarps, fixture bags, and HVAC covers.

quality_notes.all: All tape, plastic, paper, and tarps removed. Check for adhesive residue on fixtures and trim. Clean any overspray on windows or doors.

tasks.name: Scaffold / Lift Teardown
tasks.description: Dismantle scaffold, return aerial lift, or stage ladders for removal.

quality_notes.all: All access equipment removed. No damage to landscaping or hardscape from equipment.

tasks.name: Clean Spray Equipment & Tools
tasks.description: Flush airless sprayer, clean spray tips and filters, clean brushes and rollers. Proper equipment maintenance for next use.

quality_notes.all: Equipment fully flushed and clean. Spray tips inspected. Filters replaced if needed.

tasks.name: Final Site Cleanup & Demobilization
tasks.description: Collect all debris — empty containers, tape, masking paper, sheeting, rags. Restore site to pre-work condition. Load equipment and demobilize.

quality_notes.all: Site restored to pre-work condition. All debris removed. No paint splatter on hardscape or landscape.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Final inspect → Touch-up → Remove protection → Scaffold teardown → Clean equipment → Site cleanup & demobilization.

round_configurations.description: Economy vinyl repaint: wash → protect → scuff → adhesion prime (1 coat) → 1 finish coat → cleanup
round_configurations.notes: Minimum viable vinyl repaint. Adhesion primer mandatory. Single finish coat. No detail module. No caulk. Total: 2 coating passes (prime + 1 finish).

round_configurations.description: Standard vinyl repaint: wash → protect → scuff → caulk → adhesion prime (1 coat) → 2 finish coats → detail → cleanup
round_configurations.notes: Standard residential vinyl repaint. Two finish coats for full hide and durability. J-channel detail. Caulk assessment. Total: 3 coating passes (prime + 2 finish) + detail.

protection_zones.description: Adjacent landscape beds, shrubs, and plantings
protection_zones.spray_escalation: Extend coverage from 3 ft to 10 ft for spray overspray zone

protection_zones.description: Window glass and frame masking for spray operations
Exterior door masking for spray operations
Trim masking at siding-to-trim transitions for spray
Soffit/fascia at eave junction — overspray protection
protection_zones.notes: Roofline masking handled as part of trim mask setup when soffit is different color from siding.

exclusions.reason: Vinyl has single substrate state (SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT). No DSD gradient. Condition is binary: sound (repaintable) or damaged (replacement scope).
Vinyl siding is post-1960s. Never manufactured with lead coatings. Factory PVC finish is integral to material. EPA RRP does not apply.
PVC contains no tannins or extractive bleeding agents. Adhesion primer serves adhesion function only.
Factory vinyl finish does not peel, crack, or flake like paint on wood. No loose material to scrape.
Vinyl is non-porous PVC. Coating does not absorb into substrate. Backbrushing serves no purpose on vinyl.
Primed vinyl surface provides adequate adhesion for topcoat without intercoat sanding. No interstage module needed.
Vinyl is not a fine-finish substrate. QT4/QT5 excluded per resolution.
PVC does not absorb water. Moisture content testing is a wood-specific concern.
Vinyl factory finish is always PVC — not a paint coating. No coating type ambiguity.
